text.aria-label: Title text 'Each series on its own'

Subtitle text 'The pooled interval re-draws months only and says nothing about other series, so each series is shown too. 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026 (the runs that experiment 34 left out). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Below zero favours the first arm.'
